Subagents.Prompt:
Document or update the Baldur's Gate 3 mod: <MOD_QUERY>.
1. Read and follow instructions in worker skill bg3-sync-single-mod.
2. Run: bg3 modio update "<MOD_QUERY>" --json (if tracked) or bg3 modio extract --query "<MOD_QUERY>" --write-spec --json (if new).
3. Confirm mods/<mod_slug>/README.md adheres to the Rich Features Schema.
4. Return standardized status message per sync_status_messages.md:
   - Up-to-Date: <mod-slug>: No updates found (current version: v<version>)
   - Updated: <mod-slug>: Documentation updated to v<version> — <changes>
   - Created: <mod-slug>: Successfully added to library — <Brief description>
   - Failed: <mod-slug>: Failed: <reason>
